tasks.title: Define additional-service domain types
tasks.dod: src/types/additional-service.ts compiles with zero any; CreateReturnPayload is the 3-variant Destination-discriminated union per AC-04 (SenderAddress/NewAddress/NewWarehouse), never one flat optional-everything shape; the 6 items contracts/public-api.md §10 lists as open (ReturnAddressRef mapping, CheckReturnEditPossiblePayload.Address, CheckRedirectEditPossiblePayload's field list, Update*Payload's Ref name + response shape, CreateRedirectPayload.ServiceType's enum) are typed defensively (unknown/Record<string, unknown>/plain string), never falsely precise; tsc --noEmit and lint pass

tasks.title: Add requestFirst<T>() and info exposure to the core client
tasks.dod: NovaPoshtaClient gains requestFirst<T>() (ADR-0002: resolves request()'s array, returns its first element, throws NovaPoshtaApiError on an empty array with a message naming the modelName/calledMethod) and NovaPoshtaSuccessEnvelope<T> gains an optional info field surfaced by requestEnvelope() (ADR-0001); both are purely additive — request()/requestEnvelope()'s existing behavior is unchanged; unit tests cover requestFirst()'s non-empty and empty-array cases and requestEnvelope()'s info pass-through; tsc --noEmit and lint pass

tasks.title: Refactor internet-document onto the shared requestFirst<T>()
tasks.dod: internet-document's private firstOrThrow() is removed; getDocumentPrice/getDocumentDeliveryDate call client.requestFirst() instead; internet-document's existing unit suite (test/unit/modules/internet-document.test.ts) passes unmodified in behavior — same call sites, same thrown-error message shape, only the import source changes (sad.md §11 last row)

tasks.title: Implement checkReturnPossible and checkReturnEditPossible
tasks.dod: checkReturnPossible has a happy-path unit test (returns typed ReturnAddressOption[] including NonCash) and an authorization-decline test (recipient-key call throws NovaPoshtaApiError, AC-02); checkReturnEditPossible has a happy-path test asserting the assembled { options, info } result reads both requestEnvelope()'s data and info fields (ADR-0001), and a decline test

tasks.title: Implement createReturn and calculateReturn with the discriminant payload builder
tasks.dod: a shared internal payload builder strips CreateReturnPayload's Destination discriminant and sets OrderType: "orderCargoReturn" before the wire call, for all 3 variants; createReturn has a happy-path test per variant (returns { Number, Ref }) and an authorization-decline test (AC-02); calculateReturn has a test asserting the outgoing request carries OnlyGetPricing: "1" and no order is created; a compile-time test proves mixing two variants' fields under one Destination tag fails to compile, including when the payload is assembled field-by-field in a variable (AC-04)

tasks.title: Implement updateReturn
tasks.dod: updateReturn has a happy-path unit test (applies a corrected field, resolves the response as typed) and a status-decline test (a non-Accepted return's update throws NovaPoshtaApiError, AC-07) — no client-side status check is added

tasks.title: Implement getReturnOrdersList, getReturnReasons, getReturnReasonsSubtypes
tasks.dod: each of the three methods has a unit test for the unfiltered happy path, and getReturnOrdersList/getReturnReasonsSubtypes each have a second test asserting a documented filter (Number/Ref/BeginDate/EndDate/Page/Limit, ReasonRef) is passed through unmodified with no client-side re-filtering, sorting, or pagination (AC-08)

tasks.title: Implement checkRedirectPossible and checkRedirectEditPossible
tasks.dod: checkRedirectPossible has a happy-path unit test asserting it resolves one typed record via requestFirst() (not an array) and a decline test; checkRedirectEditPossible has a happy-path test (resolves the Partial<RedirectPossibility> subset) and a decline test

tasks.title: Implement createRedirect and calculateRedirect
tasks.dod: createRedirect has a happy-path unit test (returns { Number, Ref }) and a test asserting the Recipient counterparty Ref is passed through unmodified with no existence/ownership check of its own (AC-10); calculateRedirect has a test asserting the outgoing request carries OnlyGetPricing: "1" and no order is created (AC-11)

tasks.title: Implement updateRedirect and getRedirectionOrdersList
tasks.dod: updateRedirect has a happy-path unit test and a field-permission-decline test (a rejected field surfaces as NovaPoshtaApiError, AC-13) with no role parameter in the payload and no client-side role check; getRedirectionOrdersList has a happy-path test and a filter-pass-through test (AC-14)

tasks.title: Implement checkWaybillEditPossible, createWaybillEdit, getChangeEWOrdersList
tasks.dod: checkWaybillEditPossible has a happy-path unit test asserting all 11 Can... flags are returned untouched (AC-16); createWaybillEdit has a happy-path test (returns { Number, Ref }) and a test asserting a change to a flagged-not-changeable field is still sent as-is, with no client-side gating (AC-16); getChangeEWOrdersList has a happy-path test including before/after field values (AC-17)

tasks.title: Implement deleteAdditionalServiceOrder
tasks.dod: deleteAdditionalServiceOrder has a happy-path unit test covering all three order kinds (return/redirect/waybill-edit Ref, same method) and a status-decline test for a non-Accepted waybill-edit order (AC-19) — no client-side status check is added

tasks.title: Implement createReturnIfPossible
tasks.dod: createReturnIfPossible has a happy-path unit test (checks then creates in one call, returns the same shape createReturn would); an empty-option-list test asserting it throws this module's own NovaPoshtaApiError ("no return address available for this waybill") with zero create calls attempted; and a check-declined test asserting it propagates Nova Poshta's own decline with zero create calls attempted

tasks.title: Wire additional-service module into the public package surface
tasks.dod: createAdditionalServiceModule and its 19 exported types import and type-check from nova-poshta-lib's public entry point; no cross-module runtime call to internet-document/address/counterparty is added

tasks.title: Unit test suite for additional-service's shared error contract
tasks.dod: npm test passes with every AC-01..AC-23 covered by a named/tagged test, including a shared error-contract fixture (network failure, envelope-level decline, malformed data) exercised across all 19 methods with fetch mocked (AC-21/AC-22/AC-23), the OnlyGetPricing:"1" isolation check for both calculateReturn/calculateRedirect, and the <=5ms overhead benchmark across the 18 raw methods (createReturnIfPossible excluded by design)
